https://bsw.dustin-edwards.workers.dev/ (200) script-src is strict: 'strict-dynamic' beside a nonce or hash, or 'none': declared deviation: Pages are edge-cached and shared, so a per-request nonce cannot cover them, and a hash admits an external script only with an integrity attribute, which Cloudflare's manual Web Analytics beacon cannot carry (unpinned by design).
